newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai 1997/98 corn output seen at 4.53 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Thai 1997/98 corn output seen at 4.53 mln tonnes.

text.p: Thai corn output for 1997/98 (July-June) season is projected to reach 4.53 million tonnes against 4.39 million tonnes estimated for 1996/97 crop year, the agriculture ministry said in its latest forecast on Thursday.
The ministry said the increase is due to new high yielding breeds of corn.
The 1997/98 yield is expected to rise to 3.18 tonnes per hectare from 3.16 in 1996/97 crop year.
The planting area is forecast at 1.43 million hectares against 1.39 million hectares during the previous year.
Thailand is a net importer of corn and is expected to purchase between 300,000-400,000 tonnes this year, according to industry sources.
